metric: cparse: function identification and strict comparison with /lib/cparse (host/recon/strictcmp.py)
metric_def: strict: only code addresses (jump/call targets, function addresses) masked; data, bss, constants and frame offsets compared
schema: functions: name -> file (our source), orig (entry), size_orig, status (open, done, findings, crt0); manual_classes: name -> basis, d_classes, note (the only place of the notes of a finding)

audit.difference_note: unexplained instruction forms: lda	rS,A(rS); set	A,#0; set	A,#1; set	A,#2; set	A,#3
unexplained instruction forms: multl	rqS,A(rS); multl	rqS,rrS
unexplained instruction forms: multl	rqS,rrS; srl	rS,#2

defid.note: Remaining: the original places the member/structure-name block (the WEGA name space check, label mismatch) between the then and the else part of the dimension test inside the loop over the dimensions; our source has it at the PCC place behind the switch (same control flow). Tried: the PCC layout. Open: a source layout that gives the original block order (goto into the loop body like in optim?).

genswitch.note: Remaining: the size of the search table (n*SZLONG/SZCHAR as an unsigned long): the original divides with div and zero-extends, our cc shifts (srl #3) for (unsigned)(...); a new compiler difference candidate (the old cc does not turn an unsigned division by a power of 2 into a shift). Tried: (unsigned)(n*SZLONG/SZCHAR).

lxstr.note: Remaining: the lastcon |= val<<8 arm uses rr0 in the original, rr4 in ours (D2), and it is placed in front of the case bodies in the original (layout); the outer switch is a compare chain (D6).

argregs.note: Source: argregs(p->right) + argregs(p->left), so that the shipped cc calls the left one first like the original (D19); with the old cc the natural order argregs(p->left) + argregs(p->right) is expected.

rmconv.note: Source: bsize(q->type) == bsize(q->left->type) and notflt in the same order, for the call order of the original (D19).

clocal.note: Source: tbytes(l->type) > tbytes(p->type) for the call order of the original (D19); the rest are register and layout differences.

f3970.note: Used twice by the parser (yyparse); returns its argument; purpose and name open.

yyparse.note: cgram1.y is the V7/System III/Plexus grammar with one more nonterminal lcon_e (a long constant expression, lcons) for the three array dimensions: with it every yacc table (yyexca, yyact, yypact, yypgo, yyr1, yyr2, yychk, yydef) equals the original. tools/actcmp.py compares the actions rule by rule: 135 of 178 equal with frame and registers hidden; the rest are shared tails (D11), register and reload differences.
